title: Curated
Bundles
hero.lede: Three hand-picked bundles — tell your budtender which one you want and they'll put it together on the spot.

how.title: How It Works
how.text: Walk in, pick your bundle, and your budtender assembles it on the spot — no pre-ordering, no guesswork. Available exclusively in-store. Every bundle is tailored to you based on your preferences and what's in stock.

items.name: Head Stash
items.text: Built for the flower purist. A full half-ounce of high-end indoor — your budtender picks the strain based on your direction. Two pre-rolls for grab-and-go sessions and a full-spectrum edible to round out the experience. This is 14g done right.
list: ½ oz (14g) premium indoor flower — budtender's pick

items.name: Cloud 9
items.text: For the vape and concentrate crowd. A premium cartridge for on-the-go sessions, a concentrate for the real thing at home, and a full-spectrum edible to close it out. Your budtender matches everything to your preferred effect and terpene profile.

items.name: High Roller
items.text: The complete experience — flower and concentrates, maxed out at a full ounce. A half-zip of exotic or limited-run flower plus a quarter of a second premium strain, a cartridge, a concentrate, and a top-shelf edible. Head Stash meets Cloud 9 at the highest tier.
list: ½ oz (14g) exotic or limited-run flower
¼ oz (7g) premium flower — second strain

fine: Exact items vary based on current inventory and budtender recommendation. All bundles subject to availability. In-store only.
